{{rt|115|Hoenn}} }} '''Kyogre Returns''' (Japanese: '''カイオーガ、戻る''' ''Kyogre, Return'') is the 609th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 14th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Zinnia]] is surprised to be attacked by {{adv|Sapphire}} after she had seen her disappear in one of {{p|Hoopa}}'s rings. Zinnia assumes that since Sapphire is in [[Mossdeep City]], she must have given the dimensional shifter to [[Professor Cozmo]] to help power the rocket. Believing Sapphire has the scroll that can teach {{m|Dragon Ascent}} to {{p|Rayquaza}}, Zinnia has {{TP|Zinnia|Salamence}} use {{m|Fire Fang}} on [[Rono]]. Rono falls back against the tree, crushing Sapphire, who had been standing on its back. When Zinnia realizes that Sapphire doesn't know about the scroll, she attempts to leave the battle and head for the rocket, but Sapphire tackles her down. Zinnia demands to know why Sapphire is so insistent on helping the [[Devon Corporation|company]] that drained the life force of her {{p|Blaziken}}, and through a hoarse voice, Sapphire tells her that she won't let Zinnia waste [[Chic]]'s hard work. Upon realizing that Sapphire has lost her voice, a memory appears in Zinnia's mind. In a flashback, a young Zinnia finds a burnt cape on the ground—the same cape that Zinnia wears in the present. Her voice wavers as she says [[Aster]]'s name, then she finds herself unable to speak. Zinnia snaps out of the memory when Rono attacks. Salamence and Rono continue to exchange blows, and Zinnia is surprised that Sapphire's Pokémon can understand her without words. Seeing their connection, Zinnia realizes that Rono had been with Sapphire when her Salamence had attacked her and {{adv|Ruby}} as children. A voice calls out to Zinnia, and Sapphire is surprised to see that she had brought reinforcements—two duos referring to themselves as the new [[Team Magma]] and [[Team Aqua]]. They introduce themselves as [[Tabitha]], [[Courtney]], [[Matt]], and [[Shelly]], and inform Sapphire that their predecessors shared the same codenames. Zinnia notes that Tabitha and Shelly had once worked together at the Devon Corporation, but grew tired of [[Mr. Stone]]'s management over time. It is announced that the rocket will launch in three minutes, and Zinnia hops onto her Salamence and flies away. Sapphire attempts to stop her, but is attacked by Courtney's {{p|Numel}} and Matt's {{p|Carvanha}}. Seeing that she doesn't have any time to waste, Sapphire whistles, summoning her {{p|Tropius}}, [[Troppy]]. She jumps onto Troppy's back, and they race to Zinnia. Watching the launch from the [[Mossdeep Space Center]], {{Steven}}, Mr. Stone, and Professor Cozmo notice a figure approaching the rocket. They are horrified to see that it is Zinnia and her Salamence. Zinnia locates the dimensional shifter and prepares to attack it, when she is suddenly hit by a {{m|Leaf Tornado}} attack. The rocket lifts off, and Zinnia is surprised to see Sapphire and her Tropius holding onto it. Zinnia demands for Sapphire to leave, but she attempts to reason with her. While Sapphire urges her to work together to save the world, Zinnia commands Salamence to attack. Sapphire watches in shock as Salamence's claw comes for her face. With their path to [[Meteor Falls]] blocked by an energy field surrounding {{p|Groudon}} and {{p|Kyogre}}, Ruby and {{adv|Emerald}} command {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios}} and {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latias}} to try to open up a hole through it. The attack has no effect on the [[Legendary Pokémon]], and Ruby realizes that their [[type]]s must have changed in their [[Primal Reversion|new forms]]. A silhouette appears to them, confirming Ruby's theory. [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]] can suddenly be seen, standing on top of Groudon and Kyogre. They vow to teach the two Pokémon {{m|Precipice Blades}} and {{m|Origin Pulse}}, respectively, and Emerald becomes determined to stop them. He charges toward Groudon with Latias, but it swings its claw at them and knocks them away. To prevent Ruby and Emerald from stopping them, Maxie and Archie command Groudon and Kyogre to attack. The two [[Pokédex holder]]s are caught in a powerful blast that knocks them to the ground and renders them unconscious. As Maxie and Archie turn away from them, they reveal that the reason they returned to [[Hoenn]] is to protect the planet. ==Major events== * {{adv|Sapphire}} and [[Zinnia]] continue their battle. * [[Rono]] is revealed to have been present during the incident where [[Zinnia's Salamence]] attacked. * Four new {{tc|Aqua Admin|Aqua}} and {{tc|Magma Admin}}s reveal themselves, revealing that the names of [[Tabitha]], [[Shelly]], [[Matt]], and [[Courtney]] are codenames given to multiple different generations of Admins. * The rocket is successfully launched, but Zinnia follows after it with Sapphire following her. * After battling on the rocket, Zinnia attacks Sapphire with her Salamence. * {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Emerald}} attempt to get into [[Meteor Falls]], but are unable to get past [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}}. * [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]] use Groudon and Kyogre to defeat Ruby and Emerald. * Archie and Maxie reveal their reappearance is all for the sake of saving the world from destruction. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Tabitha]] * [[Shelly]] * [[Matt]] * [[Courtney]] ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * {{adv|Emerald}} * [[Steven Stone]] * [[Matt]]/{{tt|Ark}} (flashback) * [[Courtney]]/{{tt|Marge|Chuang Yi}} (flashback) * [[Tabitha]] (ORAS) * [[Shelly]] (ORAS) * [[Matt]] (ORAS) * [[Courtney]] (ORAS) * [[Tabitha]]/{{tt|Mitch|Chuang Yi}} (flashback) * [[Shelly]]/{{tt|Angie|Chuang Yi}} (flashback) * [[Zinnia]] * [[Mr. Stone]] * [[Professor Cozmo]] * [[Professor Cozmo's assistants|Watasuke, Kūta, and Nonkichi]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poochyena}} ([[Nana]];
